analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for 3 consecutive trading days. RSI has fallen from 70.9 to 65.3, exiting the overbought territory but remaining in the neutral zone. MACD histogram has worsened from 22.1135 to -11.8097, signaling a potential bearish shift. The 5-day high is lower than the 20-day high, forming a Lower High pattern, suggesting further downside potential. ADX at 46.5 indicates a clear trend, with +DI (30.7) being higher than -DI (10.7), favoring an uptrend. However, the current price ($2,459.15) is approaching the swing resistance ($2,462.8), making its breakout crucial.
